sources.title: Convallaria
sources.clean:
Convallaria is a genus of flowering plants, commonly known as lily-of-the-valley. It includes three species native to temperate Eurasia and the east-central United States.
 Image Name Distribution
 Convallaria keiskei  southeastern Siberia, Japan, Korea, northern, central, and southeastern China, Mongolia, and Myanmar
 Convallaria majalis – lily-of-the-valley Europe, Turkey, Caucasus, Kazakhstan, and central Siberia
 Convallaria pseudomajalis – American lily-of-the-valley; east-central United States (southern Appalachians from West Virginia to Georgia)

The generic name means valley in Botanical Latin, in reference to the plant's natural geographical habitat.
